_: THE connector catalogue, once: every card the Connections tab shows - the working ones (seeded as connector rows on first launch, store.py) and the planned ones - with a group, a one-line desc and `match`: the words in mail, chats, tasks and reports that mean this system. The tab reads it (connectorCatalog.js); the Advisor is handed the unconnected cards and judges which one the owner's threads are about (assistant.connect_evidence) - `match` decides nothing there any more.

sources._: Where work comes in: the groups whose working cards are a source of incoming work - mail, chat and task systems. Setup's Connect your main source offers them (email first, the usual one) and is done once one of them is connected and passes its test.

own_systems._: Systems the owner signs into that hold their own records - their databases and their books. A report source on one of these groups' cards is marked 'my own system' unless the owner turns it off, and a report run whose every source is marked is trusted (reports.is_own, origin.report_rests_on). Everything else - news, the web, social timelines, a free REST URL - starts unmarked.

actions._: WHAT THE OWNER PRESSES, PER CONNECTOR (the owner, 2026-11-05: "each connector should have settings what the action view looks like no?"). A card's `actions` lists the acts it can be set up for under a chat turn's Next steps, and one card (ActionCard.jsx) draws whatever is declared. Each: `kind` (post, email, chat, tracker), `road` (run_tool: a proposal on `tool`; reply: propose_reply / propose_email), the press words (`press`, `busy`, `done`, `undone`, `note`) and `fields`. A field has a `key` (the proposal's own), a `label` and a `type` (text, line, image, choice, people, files); `edit`: the owner may change it on the card before pressing; `agent`: the agent may propose it (general.roads tells it which); `setting`: a per-connection default on the Connections card, saved as default_<key> on the card and filled into the agent's proposal when it names none (connectorcatalog.with_defaults); a choice's own `press` / `busy` / `done` replace the act's while it is picked.
